title: Pitch curve sidecar <arbeitsordner>/noten/<sha>.<kurve>.json (notes.md, note editor spec N4): pitch and confidence per frame of one source, the detected notes, the monophonic check
description: Frame i is centred at sample i*hop; the arrays have frameZahl(frames) = floor(frames / 256) + 1 entries (checked by notes_contract.ts and the core, not expressible here). f0_ct has two decimals, konf three. The notes follow the ordering rules of audio_noten.schema.json (ordered by qa, qe[i] <= qa[i+1], qe > qa + 0.01) and carry no id. The curve id starts with the detector version that matches `detektor`. Rules over `mono` (checked by notes_contract.ts and the core): mehrstimmig is true exactly when anteil is greater than 0.30, and geprueft_frames 0 means anteil 0 and mehrstimmig false. Each note ends at most one hop after the last sample of the source (qe <= (frames + hop) / sr). `mono` is written by the command pruefe only.

f0_ct.description: Pitch per frame in cents, MIDI times 100 (A4 = 6900.0); 0 = unvoiced, otherwise 1500..11000

mono.description: Result of the monophonic check (spec N12): the share of polyphonic frames among the frames that are loud and periodic, and the two thresholds that were used
